hints.title: Numerator Maximization Identity
hints.text: In repeated division a / (b / c / d), parentheses invert denominators into multipliers: a * c * d / b.

hints.title: Fixed Denominator Invariance
hints.text: Because all numbers are at least two, placing parentheses around all elements from index one onward maximizes the resulting fraction.

hints.title: Format Output by Length Cases
hints.text: If length is one, return str(nums[0]). If length is two, return nums[0]/nums[1]. If length exceeds two, format nums[0]/(nums[1]/nums[2]/...).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full dynamic programming over all parenthesizations takes cubic O(N^3) time when a closed-form greedy arrangement exists.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recognizing that all numbers starting at index 2 can be promoted to the numerator yields a linear single-pass formatting solution.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should mathematically justify why enclosing nums[1:] in parentheses is strictly optimal for nums[i] >= 2.
